description: Data types, int overflow, integer division, Serial.print of a float and UTF-8 text, RAMEND/E2END/FLASHEND and delay() measured by millis() on the ATtiny85 (8 MHz internal).
basis: avr-gcc ABI (int 2, long 4, float and double 4 bytes); two's complement wrap-around; Print::printFloat with 2 digits; avr/iotnx5.h: RAMEND 0x25F, E2END 511, FLASHEND 0x1FFF; ATTinyCore wiring.c: timer 0 at prescaler 64 overflows every 2.048 ms, so each millis() reading lags by up to 2.048 ms and an interval of at least 587 ms measures 585 to 589

tolerances.reason: millis() advances only on the timer 0 overflow (2.048 ms at 8 MHz, prescaler 64): each of the two readings lags by up to one overflow
